full_judgment: Mr. Md. Ruhul Amin, J: This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment and order dated November 5, 2001 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 799 of 1995 making the Rule absolute upon setting aside the judgment and decree dated October 16, 1994 of the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge (Now Joint District judge) Munshiganj, in Title Appeal No. 43 of 1991 dismissing the suit upon reversing the judgment and decree dated July 17, 1991 of the Court of Senior Assistant judge, Sadar Munshiganj, in Title Suit No 60 of 1935 decreeing the same which was a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession.
